verdict.label: PASS
verdict.resolution_statement: This validator does not establish close distributional equality or +/-10-15% queue fidelity. Under the 200-replicate perfect-model audit at B = 1.40: biases of about 1.15x are generally not detected (8-13% global); about 1.25x have limited power (44-46% global); about 1.30x global biases are detected 71-73% of the time; 1.50x global bias is detected essentially always (100%); a 1.50x bias confined to one cell-and-percentile is detected 63-100% of the time depending on the cell. A passing candidate must not be described as 'matching Azure'. The supported reading is: 'No queue-behavior discrepancy was detected at the resolution supported by the preregistered validation procedure.'
